description_expanded: Overview5.0(1 review)SEAGROVE BEACH – Seagrove Shores Spacious Coastal Retreat | Steps from the Beach | Sleeps 4 DESCRIPTION Enjoy a relaxing getaway at Seagrove Shores, a bright and airy retreat in Seagrove Beach. With one bedroom, two bathrooms, and a comfortable living space, this home offers both convenience and comfort for couples or small families. Take in the views from the balcony and enjoy easy access to the beach just steps away. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax on the balcony or take a short 2-minute stroll to the beach. Beach days are simple and stress-free with nearby access to Seagrove Beach and local attractions. HOME FEATURES 1 bedroom | 2 bathrooms | Sleeps 4 Balcony Elevator access Air-conditioning throughout Sofa bed for extra sleeping space DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Fully equipped kitchen with refrigerator, microwave, oven, stovetop, dishwasher, and toaster Coffee and tea maker for your morning routine Hairdryer and essentials provided WHY STAY HERE? Prime Seagrove Beach location, just a short walk to the sand Cozy, well-designed space for couples or small families Easy access to nearby attractions, including Russell-Fields Pier and Pier Park SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 1 King bedroom Sofa bed in living area Seagrove Shores is the perfect setting for a peaceful beach vacation, whether you’re enjoying morning coffee with a view, strolling along the shore, or exploring the local area.Show less
